name: CMMC Level 1
version: CMMC Program rule 32 CFR Part 170; Level 1 Assessment Guide v2.13 (September 2024)
appliesTo: US Defense Industrial Base contractors and subcontractors that process, store or transmit Federal Contract Information (FCI) on DoD contracts.
note: Covers the 15 Level 1 security requirements from FAR 52.204-21(b)(1) (formerly counted as 17 practices); Level 2 (110 NIST SP 800-171 requirements) is not included, and mappings indicate overlap rather than equivalence.

requirements.title: Limit system access to authorized users, processes and devices
Limit system access to permitted transactions and functions
Verify and control connections to external systems
Control information posted on publicly accessible systems
Identify system users, processes and devices
Authenticate users, processes and devices before access
Sanitize or destroy media containing FCI before disposal
Limit physical access to authorized individuals
Escort visitors, log physical access, control access devices
Monitor, control and protect communications at system boundaries
Separate publicly accessible system components into subnetworks
Identify, report and correct system flaws in a timely manner
Perform periodic and real-time scans of files
